name: Michelle Delves
bio:
Hi there! My name’s Michelle and I’m a bilingual Eurasian Data, Analytics & AI Engineer at Air New Zealand with a BEng (Hons) in Engineering Science. I’m passionate about understanding physical and operational systems, connecting them with the data they generate, and translating that knowledge into trusted digital solutions with the bigger picture and long-term impact in mind.
Outside of work, I’m an avid musician. I’ve studied piano, violin and voice, taught music since 2020, and sung with one of New Zealand’s national choirs. I’m also passionate about equity and inclusion, particularly supporting women in STEM and creating opportunities for others to thrive.
